assertions.name: covariance_epic_A2_odd_moment_structure
assertions.source: Odd hook-power moments characterized exactly (n<=14): non-polynomial; strictly log-convex hence not a positive-measure moment sequence; exact transpose identity M_1=2·Cov(n_λ,Σc²); empirically positive but positivity OPEN. No fit; no c_k.

description: Structure of the ODD hook-power moments M_k=Cov_Planch(Σ_□ h^k,Σ_□ h²) of the covariance measure (qou-x631, qou-ogrk), companion to the proved even-moment positivity. Exact Fraction, n=3..14. Findings: (1) ODD moments are NON-POLYNOMIAL (Σh^{2j+1} not shifted-symmetric; degree-d interpolation of M_1,M_3,M_5 mispredicts). (2) The moment sequence is strictly LOG-CONVEX (M_{k+1}²>M_k·M_{k+2}, i.e. every 2×2 Hankel minor M_i M_{i+2}−M_{i+1}²<0) ⇒ NOT the moment sequence of any positive measure (reverse Cauchy–Schwarz fails) — kills the ∫v^k dν, ν≥0 positivity route. (3) EXACT transpose identity M_1(n)=2·Cov_Planch(n_λ,Σc²) with n_λ=Σ_i i·λ_i (from Σh=n_λ+n_λ'+n and Plancherel transpose-invariance) — reduces the first odd moment to a covariance of the SAME difficulty class as the open kernel. (4) M_1,M_3,M_5,M_7>0 for all n tested, but log-convexity+even positivity does NOT bootstrap odd signs (relates the squares) — odd positivity stays OPEN. Structural characterization, not a proof of odd positivity/A2/kernel. scope-(a); no fit; nothing wired; no c_k; L2 2/7.

data.odd_positivity_status: OPEN (log-convexity relates squares; no sign bootstrap)
